entries.name: S42 Arcade Hunter Season
entries.detail: S42 Arcade Hunter Season (March 1st - April 30th) awards will be granted. Queen Top 20 receives the S41 badge; Queen receives 320 Candies, Crown valid in S43, and Arcade Hunter (Legendary); King receives 320 Candies and Arcade Hunter (Mythical); Rook receives 160 Candies and Arcade Hunter (Rare); Bishop receives 80 Candies and Arcade Hunter (Common); Knight receives 40 Candies; Pawn receives 20 Candies.

entries.name: Season settlement
entries.detail: Badges will be settled by final season ranking. All other awards will be settled by highest rank in season. The last day of the season is casual for award settlement; S43 Stilla Ranger Season starts May 1st, 2026.

entries.name: S43 season start
entries.detail: S43 has been kicked off - enjoy the new season and claim your S42 awards. You'll need 5 games to settle your ranking as usual.
